s: trade restriction, trade barrier (a government-imposed restriction on the free exchange of goods or services between nations)
Die neue Handelsbeschränkung zielt darauf ab, den Import von Luxusgütern zu drosseln.
The new trade restriction aims to curb the import of luxury goods.
Unternehmen leiden oft unter einer bürokratischen Handelsbeschränkung, die den Markteintritt erschwert.
Companies often suffer from a bureaucratic trade restriction that makes market entry difficult.
trade margin, markup (the difference between the purchasing price and the selling price of a product, often expressed as a percentage of the selling price)
Im Großhandel ist die Handelsspanne meist geringer als im Einzelhandel.
In wholesale, the trade margin is usually lower than in retail.
Luxusgüter zeichnen sich oft durch eine extrem hohe Handelsspanne aus.
Luxury goods are often characterized by an extremely high trade margin.
trading profit (the profit generated specifically from the buying and selling of goods or financial assets, typically calculated before operating expenses and taxes)
Trotz sinkender Margen konnte das Unternehmen den Handelsgewinn durch eine massive Erhöhung des Volumens stabil halten.
Despite falling margins, the company was able to keep the trading profit stable by massively increasing volume.
Der Handelsgewinn der Banken resultiert oft aus der Differenz zwischen An- und Verkaufskursen von Wertpapieren.
The trading profit of banks often results from the difference between the buying and selling prices of securities.
trading halt, trading suspension (a temporary suspension of trading for a specific security or an entire exchange, often due to extreme volatility or pending news)
Die Börsenaufsicht verhängte einen vorübergehenden Handelsstopp, um die Wirtschaftskraft der Anleger vor den Folgen irrationaler Panikverkäufe zu bewahren.
The stock exchange supervisory authority imposed a temporary trading halt to protect the economic power of investors from the consequences of irrational panic selling.

Ein angekündigter Handelsstopp gibt Unternehmen die notwendige Zeit, kursrelevante Informationen zu veröffentlichen, ohne die Zahlungskraft der Marktteilnehmer durch Informationsasymmetrien zu gefährden.
An announced trading halt gives companies the necessary time to publish price-sensitive information without endangering the solvency of market participants through information asymmetries.
trading platform (a software system used to trade financial products, such as stocks, bonds, or currencies, via a network)
Die Wahl der richtigen Handelsplattform ist entscheidend für die operative Wirtschaftskraft professioneller Daytrader.
Choosing the right trading platform is crucial for the operational economic power of professional day traders.
Moderne Handelsplattformen im Wissenssektor bieten Echtzeit-Analysen an, die die Zahlungskraft der Nutzer durch präzisere Markteinstiege schützen sollen.
Modern trading platforms in the knowledge sector offer real-time analyses designed to protect users' solvency through more precise market entries.
trading liquidity (the ease with which a specific security can be traded on the market without causing significant price movement)
Eine hohe Handelsliquidität ist für institutionelle Anleger eine Grundvoraussetzung, um die Wirtschaftskraft ihrer Portfolios effizient zu verwalten.
High trading liquidity is a prerequisite for institutional investors to efficiently manage the economic power of their portfolios.
Fehlende Handelsliquidität kann die Zahlungskraft eines Marktteilnehmers in Krisenzeiten gefährden, wenn Positionen nur mit hohen Abschlägen veräußert werden können.
A lack of trading liquidity can jeopardize a market participant's solvency in times of crisis if positions can only be sold at high discounts.
trading volume (the total amount of a specific security or the total value of all securities traded within a market during a given period)
Ein hohes Handelsvolumen an der Börse deutet auf eine hohe Marktliquidität hin.
A high trading volume on the stock exchange indicates high market liquidity.
trade volume, volume of trade (the total value or quantity of goods and services exchanged between two countries or within a region; the sum of exports and imports)
Das Handelsvolumen zwischen der EU und China hat im letzten Jahr trotz globaler Krisen weiter zugenommen.
The trade volume between the EU and China has continued to increase over the past year despite global crises.
trade relationship, commercial relation (the ongoing exchange of goods, services, and capital between two parties, such as companies or nations)
Eine stabile Handelsbeziehung ist das Rückgrat der Wirtschaftskraft zwischen langjährigen Partnerstaaten der Industriegesellschaft.
A stable trade relationship is the backbone of economic power between long-standing partner states of industrial society.
Im globalen Wissenssektor basieren Handelsbeziehungen zunehmend auf dem Austausch von Daten und Patenten, was die langfristige Zahlungskraft der beteiligten Akteure sichert.
In the global knowledge sector, trade relationships are increasingly based on the exchange of data and patents, which secures the long-term solvency of the parties involved.
trade conflict, commercial dispute (a disagreement or dispute between two or more nations or economic blocs regarding trade policies, tariffs, or market access)
Ein eskalierender Handelskonflikt kann die globale Wirtschaftskraft schwächen, indem er Lieferketten unterbricht und die Kosten für Rohstoffe erhöht.
An escalating trade conflict can weaken global economic power by disrupting supply chains and increasing the costs of raw materials.
Im modernen Wissenssektor drehen sich viele Handelskonflikte um den Schutz geistigen Eigentums, was die langfristige Zahlungskraft innovativer Unternehmen sichern soll.
In the modern knowledge sector, many trade conflicts revolve around the protection of intellectual property, which is intended to secure the long-term solvency of innovative companies.
trading partner (a person, company, or country that carries on trade with another)
Ein verlässlicher Handelspartner ist essenziell für die langfristige Wirtschaftskraft einer Industriegesellschaft.
A reliable trading partner is essential for the long-term economic power of an industrial society.
Im digitalen Wissenssektor ermöglicht ein vertrauenswürdiger Handelspartner den sicheren Datenaustausch und schützt so die gegenseitige Zahlungskraft.
In the digital knowledge sector, a trustworthy trading partner enables secure data exchange, thereby protecting mutual solvency.
start of trading (the commencement of the official trading session on an exchange)
commercial launch (the start of sales for a new product or service)
trading day; business day (a day on which an exchange is open for trading)
trading hours (the specific period during which an exchange is open and trading activity occurs)
trading surveillance office (an independent exchange body that monitors trading activity to prevent market abuse and ensure compliance with exchange rules)
